instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past perfect progressive.

Das past perfect progressive zeigt, dass eine Handlung über einen Zeitraum andauerte, bevor eine zweite Handlung in der Vergangenheit eintrat. Achte auf die markierten Signalwörter.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past perfect progressive.

atoms.b: I ((++had_been_hanging_out am_hanging_out)) with them <u>since</u> 8th grade <u>before</u> we argued.
I ((++had_been_studying have_been_studying)) <u>for</u> three hours <u>before</u> I took a break.
He ((++had_been_thinking will_have_been_thinking)) about his future <u>every day</u> <u>before</u> choosing a career.

instruction.text:
Fill in the gap, using the past perfect progressive.

Das past perfect progressive zeigt eine andauernde oder eine kürzlich beendete Vorvergangenheit an.
instruction.sound: Fill in the gap, using the past perfect progressive.

atoms.b: She ((had_been_feeling)) sad <u>since</u> Monday without telling anyone, <u>but it ended</u> after she opened up.
He ((had_been_acting)) differently <u>since</u> the argument, <u>but it had stopped</u> after we talked.
He ((had_been_playing)) video games <u>for</u> hours <u>before</u> his dad checked on him.
I ((had_been_aiming)) to become a cook <u>since</u> I was a child <u>before</u> I chose another career.

instruction.text: Why is the past perfect progressive used here?

atoms.a: She had been learning French until she decided to switch to Spanish.
I had been playing the guitar when my friend knocked on the door.
He had been working on his speech for a week.
We had been waiting for over 20 minutes.
